newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: GUNMEN KILL THREE IN S.AFRICA'S KWAZULU-NATAL.
newsitem.headline: GUNMEN KILL THREE IN S.AFRICA'S KWAZULU-NATAL.

text.p: Gunmen killed two adults and a six-year-old child in an attack on their home in South Africa's troubled KwaZulu-Natal province, police said on Monday.
"Sammy Khowa, 6, and her aunt Happiness Khowa, 30, were both fatally shot in the head by attackers," a spokesman said.
Dingikhaya Khowa, 70, was burnt to death in a separate room in the Sunday night attack near Paddock on the Indian Ocean coast.

The watchdog Human Rights Committee, which monitors political violence, said since July over 90 people have been killed in unceasing friction between Zulu supporters of President Nelson Mandela's ruling African National Congress and rivals of the traditionalist Inkatha Freedom Party.
The continual killings could derail a fragile four-month-old peace agreed to by leaders of the two parties just weeks before the June local government elections in the province, the committee warned.
Over 14,000 people have been killed in a decade-long struggle between the country's two largest black political parties to gain control of KwaZulu-Natal.
